metrics.profile_summary: Digital Marketing Specialist with expertise in marketing strategy, branding, and social media management. Strong track record in creating data-driven campaigns and visual assets to enhance brand visibility.

experience.description: Led digital marketing initiatives, conducted competitor research, managed social media content calendars, and designed branded assets using Canva.
Created social media campaigns and branded graphics while managing content planning and publishing across multiple platforms.
Developed learning materials and strengthened communication and organizational skills through classroom management.
Managed social media platforms, designed event visuals, and handled photography and video editing for educational programs.

strengths: Proficient in Canva and Meta tools
Direct experience with content calendars and competitor research
Strong technical analytics stack (GA4, Looker Studio, Meta Pixel)
weaknesses: Academic degree is in Education rather than Marketing or Mass Communication
evaluation.summary: The candidate exceeds technical requirements and meets the minimum experience threshold. Despite the unrelated degree, their professional track record and certifications make them an ideal fit for the role.
